subject.title: feat(exec): expose knownLongFlags in safeBinProfiles config schema

question: Should OpenClaw add public recognized-boolean-flag configuration for custom safe-bin profiles, and if so is `knownLongFlags` the intended stable field rather than a higher-level boolean-flag allowlist?
rationale: Both the proposed low-level field and a higher-level boolean-flag contract can solve the behavior gap, but selecting a permanent security-sensitive operator API requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Close pending sponsorship
options.body: Close this technically sound PR now and reopen or submit a narrowed version when an exec-policy owner explicitly sponsors the public configuration direction.

options.title: Sponsor a higher-level API
options.body: Approve custom boolean flags as a product capability while keeping `knownLongFlags` derived and internal.

options.title: Sponsor this exact field
options.body: Accept `knownLongFlags` as the durable public config contract and own its compatibility and security semantics.

recommendation.title: Close pending sponsorship
recommendation.body: Close this technically sound PR now and reopen or submit a narrowed version when an exec-policy owner explicitly sponsors the public configuration direction.
